label: Читать
description: A full conjugation deck for читать: present persons, past, future, imperative, and reading objects.

missions.phrase: Вечером я читаю интересную книгу.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: First-person singular present, imperfective. 'Читаю' is the standard я-form with the -ю ending. 'Книгу' is the accusative direct object; 'интересную' agrees in case. The core reading template.

missions.phrase: Утром я читаю свежую газету.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: First-person singular present, imperfective. 'Читаю' repeats the я-form for fluency. 'Газету' is the feminine accusative object; 'свежую' agrees. A common everyday reading collocation.

missions.phrase: Ты внимательно читаешь это письмо.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Second-person singular present, imperfective. 'Читаешь' shows the -ешь ending of the first conjugation. 'Письмо' is the neuter accusative object; 'внимательно' adds manner.

missions.phrase: Ты медленно читаешь сложный текст.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Second-person singular present, imperfective. 'Читаешь' reinforces the ты-form ending -ешь. 'Текст' is the masculine accusative object; 'сложный' agrees. A study-context phrase.

missions.phrase: Вечером он читает любимую книгу.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Third-person singular present, imperfective. 'Читает' is the он/она-form ending in -ет. 'Книгу' is the accusative object; 'любимую' agrees. A core daily-life sentence.

missions.phrase: За завтраком она читает газету.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Third-person singular present, imperfective. 'Читает' covers the feminine subject 'она' with the -ет ending. 'Газету' is the accusative object. A natural everyday phrase.

missions.phrase: На уроке мы читаем новый текст.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: First-person plural present, imperfective. 'Читаем' shows the мы-form ending -ем. 'Текст' is the accusative object; 'новый' agrees. A reusable group-reading pattern.

missions.phrase: По вечерам мы читаем книги вместе.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: First-person plural present, imperfective. 'Читаем' reinforces the мы-form -ем. 'Книги' is the plural accusative object; 'вместе' means 'together'. A shared-activity phrase.

missions.phrase: Вы внимательно читаете моё письмо.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Second-person plural or polite present, imperfective. 'Читаете' trains the respectful вы-address with -ете. 'Письмо' is the neuter accusative object. A polite reading sentence.

missions.phrase: Дети с интересом читают эту книгу.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Third-person plural present, imperfective. 'Читают' closes the present set with the -ют ending. 'Книгу' is the accusative object; 'с интересом' adds manner. Completes the ladder.

missions.phrase: Утром родители читают газету на кухне.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Third-person plural present, imperfective. 'Читают' repeats the они-form ending -ют. 'Газету' is the accusative object. A common phrase about a group reading.

missions.phrase: Вчера вечером я читал интересную книгу.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Masculine past tense, imperfective. 'Читал' is the masculine singular past form. 'Вчера' fixes the time frame. The imperfective past stresses the ongoing process of reading.

missions.phrase: Утром она долго читала это письмо.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Feminine past tense, imperfective. 'Читала' adds the feminine -а ending. 'Письмо' is the neuter accusative object; 'долго' stresses the ongoing past action.

missions.phrase: Радио весь день читало последние новости.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Neuter past tense, imperfective. 'Читало' agrees with the neuter subject 'радио' via -о. 'Новости' is the plural accusative object 'news'. Trains the rarer neuter past.

missions.phrase: На уроке студенты читали трудный текст.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Plural past tense, imperfective. 'Читали' is the plural past form ending in -и. 'Текст' is the accusative object; 'трудный' agrees. Completes the four past forms.

missions.phrase: Завтра я буду читать новую книгу.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Imperfective compound future. 'Буду читать' joins 'буду' with the infinitive 'читать'. 'Книгу' is the accusative object. Signals a planned, ongoing future reading.

missions.phrase: Вчера я наконец прочитал эту книгу.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Perfective past, masculine, aspect contrast. 'Прочитал' is perfective прочитать, marking a finished result. 'Наконец' underscores completion versus imperfective 'читал'.

missions.phrase: Завтра утром я прочитаю твоё письмо.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Perfective future, first-person singular, aspect contrast. 'Прочитаю' is perfective прочитать with future meaning. 'Завтра' marks time; it stresses a completed result, not the process.

missions.phrase: Сегодня она уже прочитала всю газету.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Perfective past, feminine, aspect contrast. 'Прочитала' is the feminine perfective form. 'Газету' is the accusative object; 'уже' marks the reading as finished.

missions.phrase: Пожалуйста, читай этот текст вслух.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Singular imperative, imperfective. 'Читай' is the informal command form. 'Текст' is the accusative object; 'вслух' means 'aloud'. A direct everyday instruction to one person.

missions.phrase: Дети, читайте текст внимательно и медленно.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Plural or polite imperative, imperfective. 'Читайте' adds -те for respectful or group commands. 'Текст' is the accusative object. A polite classroom instruction.

missions.phrase: Я очень люблю читать хорошие книги.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Modal infinitive use, imperfective. 'Люблю' governs the imperfective infinitive 'читать'. 'Книги' is the plural accusative object; 'хорошие' agrees. A natural preference sentence.
